quarterly_data.signal: NextEra Energy's 10-Q: estimated capital expenditures as of June 30, 2026 for the remainder of 2026 through 2030 include new wind projects and repowering totaling approximately 3,637 MW, new solar projects (including solar plus battery storage) totaling approximately 16,245 MW and primarily battery storage projects totaling approximately 6,115 MW, each with related transmission. NEER's contracts primarily for the purchase of wind turbines, wind towers, solar modules, batteries and transmission equipment and related construction and development activities, and for the supply of uranium and the conversion, enrichment and fabrication of nuclear fuel (expiration dates through 2033), carry approximately $10.1 billion of commitments included in those estimates.

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures, independent power and other investments and nuclear fuel purchases for the six months ended June 30, 2026 were $19,389 million versus $13,626 million a year earlier: FPL $5,932 million (new generation $2,123 million vs $1,152 million; transmission and distribution $2,346 million) and NEER $13,449 million (solar including solar plus battery storage $6,337 million vs $3,480 million).
